extraction_notes: BZX584C3V6 is identified as BZX584C5V6 in the bundled datasheet family table; nominal VZ is 5.6 V, minimum 5.2 V, and maximum 6.0 V at IZT = 5 mA.
Maximum zener impedance is ZZT = 40 ohm at IZT = 5 mA; knee impedance is ZZK = 400 ohm at IZK = 1 mA.
Admissible zener current IZM is 5 mA; typical temperature coefficient range is -2 to +2.5 mV/degC.
The plotted 5.6 V trace is read from the generic BZX584CXXX pulsed characteristic figure.
omission_reason: No capacitance or reverse-recovery table value was published. The capacitance figure is a generic capacitance-versus-nominal-zener-voltage plot rather than a bias-specific 5.6 V capacitance measurement.
